name: Matrix Docker Build (Node 22 & 24)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22, 24]

    name: Build Node ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Optional: Run tests outside Docker
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install & Test
        run: |
          npm install
          npm test

      # Build Docker image with dynamic Node version
      - name: Build Docker Image
        run: |
          docker build \
            --build-arg NODE_VERSION=${{ matrix.node-version }} \
            -t myapp:${{ matrix.node-version }} .

      # Optional: Push to registry
      - name: Tag Image
        run: |
          docker tag myapp:${{ matrix.node-version }} myrepo/myapp:${{ matrix.node-version }}
